headline.en: Turn a replayed injection into an inspectable training record.
headline.zh: 把重放的注入转成可检查的训练记录。

sub.en: RedLoop creates attack examples, replays them through a built-in tool loop and exports successful forbidden-call traces with a suggested safe response.
sub.zh: RedLoop 生成攻击示例，在内置工具循环中重放，并为成功触发的禁止调用导出轨迹与建议安全响应。

body.en: Payload, location, outcome and trace stay together.
body.zh: 载荷、位置、结果与轨迹保存在一起。

body.en: The demo and deterministic generator run locally.
body.zh: 示例与确定性生成器可本地运行。

body.en: Reports distinguish model generation from deterministic fallback.
body.zh: 报告区分模型生成与确定性回退。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Python 3.12+; replay the complete bundled fixture and read its JSONL record from a temporary directory.
note.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+；重放完整随仓 fixture，并从临时目录回读 JSONL 记录。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: A bundled injection fixture runs against the deliberately naive in-memory target and emits a training record. Email is only an in-memory list; no external action occurs.

body.en: Python 3.12+; replay the complete bundled fixture and read its JSONL record from a temporary directory.
body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+；重放完整随仓 fixture，并从临时目录回读 JSONL 记录。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/redloop.git
cd redloop
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.en: The target is a deliberately naive rule-based mock, not a live LLM agent. Its hit rate does not measure security of external agents or models.
limitations.zh: 目标是刻意朴素的规则模拟器，不是在线 LLM Agent；其命中率不衡量外部 Agent 或模型的安全性。

limitations.en: send_email writes to an in-memory mailbox; the demo sends no email or user data. forbidden_tools labels detected calls rather than acting as a runtime blocking policy.
limitations.zh: send_email 只写内存邮箱，示例不发送邮件或用户数据。forbidden_tools 用来标注检测到的调用，不是运行时阻断策略。

limitations.en: The exported safe responses are templates for review. No fine-tuning or measured hardening improvement is performed.
limitations.zh: 导出的 safe_response 是待审阅模板；工具未进行微调或测量防护改善。

body.en: A reusable example needs more than a payload string. Keeping the injection location, observed call and expected safe behavior together gives reviewers the context needed to judge a candidate training record.
body.zh: 可复用示例需要的不只是载荷字符串。把注入位置、观察到的调用与期望安全行为放在一起，便于审阅候选训练记录。

body.en: The attacker supplies seeded mutations or optional model-generated payloads. Replay constructs a fresh deterministic target with in-memory tools, records forbidden calls, and the hardening module serializes attack, outcome, safe_response and exploit_trace. Reports aggregate the replay outcomes.
body.zh: attacker 提供种子变体或可选模型生成载荷；replay 构造新的确定性内存工具目标并记录禁止调用。hardening 将 attack、outcome、safe_response、exploit_trace 序列化，报告汇总重放结果。

body.en: The attacker supplies seeded mutations or optional model-generated payloads. Replay constructs a fresh deterministic target with in-memory tools, records forbidden calls, and the hardening module serializes attack, outcome, safe_response and exploit_trace. Reports aggregate the replay outcomes.
body.zh: attacker 提供种子变体或可选模型生成载荷；replay 构造新的确定性内存工具目标并记录禁止调用。hardening 将 attack、outcome、safe_response、exploit_trace 序列化，报告汇总重放结果。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: redloop.toml defines attacker model, base_url, temperature, n_attacks, max_tokens and timeout; target defines forbidden_tools, max_steps and optional system_prompt. REDLOOP_ATTACKER_KEY enables online attack generation. Without a key the ordinary run uses deterministic generation; API failure can also fall back, so inspect attacker_mode. --no-emit avoids an output file; --emit selects JSONL, which is overwritten per campaign.
body.zh: redloop.toml 配置 attacker 的 model、base_url、temperature、n_attacks、max_tokens、timeout；target 配置 forbidden_tools、max_steps 与可选 system_prompt。REDLOOP_ATTACKER_KEY 启用在线攻击生成。无密钥时普通 run 使用确定性生成，API 失败也可能回退，因此须检查 attacker_mode。--no-emit 不输出文件；--emit 指定 JSONL，每轮会覆盖。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
redloop run --preset demo --emit demo-hardening.jsonl
redloop probe
# Review redloop.toml before a campaign:
redloop run --no-emit --n 4
